subject.title: fix(reef): contain startup friend reconcile failures

question: Should Reef activate after a retryable startup friend-reconcile failure using persisted peer keys, rather than fail account startup until a fresh relay response succeeds?
rationale: The code is deliberately choosing an operational policy between channel availability during relay throttling and guaranteed fresh peer keys before activation; automated review cannot safely select that product boundary.

options.title: Approve availability-first startup
options.body: Accept the proposed symmetry with periodic reconciliation: report retryable failures, activate with persisted keys, and retry on the next interval.

options.title: Require fresh keys before activation
options.body: Keep startup fail-closed for all reconciliation failures, preserving key freshness at the cost of supervisor restart behavior during relay outages.

recommendation.title: Approve availability-first startup
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed symmetry with periodic reconciliation: report retryable failures, activate with persisted keys, and retry on the next interval.
